About Us

The Chemical Engineering Undergraduate Society (CEUS) is the vibrant student-run society for students within the School of Chemical Engineering at The University of New South Wales (UNSW). We are dedicated to enhancing the academic, social, and professional lives of our members. Through a diverse range of events and initiatives, we foster a strong sense of community and provide valuable opportunities for growth and connection.
